Overview
Kasol Kheerganga Trek from Delhi
Get ready for an unforgettable Himalayan adventure with the Kheerganga Trek, one of Himachal’s most popular and scenic trails. This 12 km trek takes you through dense pine forests, cascading waterfalls, wooden bridges, and breathtaking mountain views. Once you reach the summit, you’ll be rewarded with the iconic Parvati Kund, a natural hot water spring
The perfect place to unwind after the climb. Along with the trek, this trip also includes exploring Kasol and the serene Parvati Valley. Known as “Mini Israel,” Kasol is famous for its riverside cafés, backpacker culture, hostels with mountain views, and relaxed vibes. The entire region is filled with natural beauty, from hot water springs and forest trails to stunning valley landscapes and peaceful riverside spots. Whether you’re a nature lover, adventure seeker, photographer, or someone craving a refreshing break, this backpacking journey through Kasol and Kheerganga promises memories you’ll never forget.
Key Highlights of the Kasol Kheerganga Trek from Delhi
Kasol: Explore the Kasol Market, walk along the Parvati River, visit the scenic Chalal Village, and enjoy café hopping at popular spots in Kasol — perfect for backpackers and food lovers.
Manikaran: Visit the famous Manikaran Gurudwara and Shiva Temple, and experience the natural Manikaran Hot Water Spring, known for its spiritual and healing significance in Himachal Pradesh.
Kheerganga: Trek to the stunning Kheerganga Summit and unwind in the natural Parvati Kund Hot Spring. Explore attractions like the Kartikeya Temple, the beautiful Rudranaag Waterfall, and Rudranaag Temple — key highlights of the Kheerganga Trek experience.

Kasol – Kheerganga Backpacking Trip Itinerary (5 Days)
Day 01: Delhi ➜ Kasol (Overnight Travel)
Arrive in Delhi by late morning. Make your way to Akshardham  and report by 9 :00 PM .
Board your Volvo/AC vehicle (between 6:30–9:00 PM) and begin your overnight journey toward the mountains.
Day 02: Arrive in Kasol – Explore
Reach Kasol and check in. Spend the day chilling in the mountains — explore Kasol Market, try riverside walks, café hop (Israeli food is a must!), and soak in the relaxed Parvati Valley vibes.
In the evening, take a light hike to Chalal Village and enjoy stunning valley views.
Dinner and overnight stay at campsite/hostel.
Day 03: Kasol ➜ Barshaini ➜ Kheerganga
Wake up early, have breakfast, and drive to Barshaini — the starting point of the trek.
Begin your scenic Kheerganga Trek (12 km) through pine forests, waterfalls, and wooden bridges.
Reach Kheerganga by evening, relax at the top, enjoy a bonfire dinner, and sleep under a starlit Himalayan sky.
Day 04: Kheerganga ➜ Barshaini ➜ Manikaran ➜ Kasol ➜ Delhi
Wake up to mountain views and breakfast.
Descend back to Barshaini and visit Manikaran Gurudwara Sahib and its hot springs.
Spend some free time in Kasol before boarding the evening bus (~6:00 PM) back to Delhi.
Overnight travel.
Day 05: Arrival in Delhi
Reach Delhi in the morning by 6 am. Trip ends with memories, photos, and stories you’ll talk about for years!
From chilled café days in Kasol to trekking through magical forests to Kheerganga — this trip is the perfect mix of adventure, nature, food, and mountain vibes.

Itinerary
Day 1
Day 01 - Delhi to Kasol
Akshardham Delhi
+
Arrive in Delhi. From the airport or railway station, you can either take a cab for sightseeing (Delhi Darshan) or head directly to Akshardham. Please report at Akshardham. From here, we will board our Volvo/AC cab to Kasol (departure between 9:00 PM) and begin our overnight journey to the mountains.
Day 2
Day 02 - Kasol - Chalal
Kasol
+
Welcome to Kasol – the chill capital of Himachal!
Check in, drop your bags, take a deep breath… because the mountains, pine-scented air, and Parvati River are officially your new vibe.
Wander through the quirky Kasol market, pick up some boho souvenirs, and then take a relaxing riverside walk toward Chalal Village. Trust us — the sound of the river and the mountain views hit differently here.
Feeling hungry? Perfect. Kasol is famous for its Israeli cafés — so get ready to try Shakshuka, Hummus, Nutella waffles, and other mind-blowing backpacker favourites.
Later in the evening, head for a short hike to Chalal. The trail is peaceful, scenic, and filled with postcard-worthy views of the Parvati Valley. This is your moment to unplug, unwind, and fall in love with the mountains.
End the day with a warm, cozy dinner at the campsite/hotel and maybe sit by a bonfire if the vibes are right.
Tomorrow, adventure gets real — but today is all about chilling, exploring, and soaking in Kasol’s magic.
Day 3
Day 03: Kasol Barshaini Kheerganga Trek
Barshaini Bus Stand
+
Wake up early — the mountains are calling and today is the big adventure day! After breakfast, we’ll drive to Barshaini , the starting point of the iconic Kheerganga Trek .
From here, the fun begins. The trail winds through dense forests, waterfalls, wooden bridges, and stunning views of the Parvati Valley. Take your time, enjoy the scenery, breathe in the fresh mountain air, and let the journey unfold.
By evening, reach Kheerganga , where the mountains open up into a peaceful meadow. Settle into your camp, enjoy a cozy bonfire dinner, and watch a sky full of stars — the kind you rarely see in cities.
Sleep under the Himalayan sky — tomorrow, more magic awaits.
Day 4
Day 04: Kheerganga - Barshaini - Manikaran - Kasol - Delhi
Manikaran
+
Wake up early and enjoy your last morning in the mountains — fresh air, valley views, and the sound of nature all around. After breakfast, begin your descent back to Barshaini, soaking in the trail one last time.
From there, we’ll visit the peaceful and iconic Manikaran Gurudwara Sahib, famous for its natural hot springs and spiritual atmosphere — a perfect recharge after the trek.
Before leaving Kasol, you’ll have time to grab souvenirs, chill at a café, or enjoy one last riverside moment in the Parvati Valley.
By evening, we board our bus (around 6:00 PM) and begin our comfortable overnight journey back to Delhi.
Rest well — you just completed one of the most memorable Himalayan treks
Day 5
Day 05: Delhi
Akshardham Delhi
